column1: # How a date in a response header reads, read by both test suites: as Chrome reads Expires, Date and
# Last-Modified, with a missing zone as GMT. `ms` is milliseconds since the epoch, `-` for no date. Each value is
# written from what the string means; http-cache.tsv holds the measured forms to Chrome's cache, past and future.
a word that spells a month
offset after a named zone is ignored

# ÉST as no zone (http-cache.tsv: "reading a letter outside ASCII").
a letter outside ASCII is no letter
Z after the time overrides an earlier zone
an offset glued to the time
an offset then a zone word

a dash after a word before any year separates

six digits are no numeric date

a number before a dot still counts
no AM or PM after Z
six digits are no numeric date even as a small year
